related.title: MITRE ATT&CK：資料先決條件與可驗證覆蓋
related.titleEn: MITRE ATT&CK: data prerequisites and verifiable coverage
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付12列抑制真值表、缺標籤測試與修正前後差異，原始警示不因抑制而消失。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver twelve inhibition decisions, missing-label fixtures and before/after differences, retaining all original alerts.
related.difference: 建立選定行為、所需資料、可用感測器、驗證樣本與結果五欄矩陣，區分規則存在與證據成立。
related.differenceEn: Map selected behaviors to required data, available sensors, test fixtures and outcomes, distinguishing rule existence from verified evidence.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 抑制可減少重複通知但不刪除事件；跨租戶誤抑制的代價需單獨計數而非視為降噪成功。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 有12筆target，A租戶8、B租戶4；A故障source本應只抑制A的8筆，缺tenant鍵卻抑制全部12筆。 錯誤抑制4筆，占原12筆target的33.333333%；本課不用此比例推論整體風險。
可驗證覆蓋須滿足資料可用及測試成功兩條件；未測、不可測與測試失敗應分開。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 選20項教學行為，16項有對應規則，12項資料先決條件滿足，當中9項通過合成驗證。 已驗證覆蓋9/20=45%；16/20=80%只描述規則標籤存在，不是相同量。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Inhibition reduces notifications without deleting events; cross-tenant suppression must be counted separately from useful noise reduction. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Twelve targets include eight in tenant A and four in B; an A source should inhibit eight, but a missing tenant key suppresses all twelve. Four targets are suppressed incorrectly, or 33.333333% of the original target set, without implying a global risk probability.

Verifiable coverage requires both available data and passing tests; untested, untestable and failed cases remain distinct. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Select twenty teaching behaviors: sixteen have rules, twelve have required data, and nine of those pass synthetic validation. Verified coverage is 45%; the 80% rule-tag presence describes a different quantity.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Autopsy 4.22：雜湊集合版本與路徑、內容的雙重分母
related.titleEn: Autopsy 4.22: hash-set versions and separate path/content denominators
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付12列抑制真值表、缺標籤測試與修正前後差異，原始警示不因抑制而消失。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver twelve inhibition decisions, missing-label fixtures and before/after differences, retaining all original alerts.
related.difference: 建立路徑到內容雜湊的映射，固定雜湊集合版本及類別；同時報告路徑覆蓋與唯一內容覆蓋，保留未命中的檔案。
related.differenceEn: Build a path-to-content-hash mapping, pin the hash-set version and classification, and report both path coverage and unique-content coverage while retaining all unmatched files for further review.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 抑制可減少重複通知但不刪除事件；跨租戶誤抑制的代價需單獨計數而非視為降噪成功。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 有12筆target，A租戶8、B租戶4；A故障source本應只抑制A的8筆，缺tenant鍵卻抑制全部12筆。 錯誤抑制4筆，占原12筆target的33.333333%；本課不用此比例推論整體風險。

Autopsy雜湊查找比對指定集合，集合內容改變可能需要重跑處理；命中表示與集合中內容相符，不證明環境、用途或執行行為無害。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 有100條路徑、80個唯一內容雜湊；集合v1命中50個內容，分布在65條路徑。所有數值為人工可列舉的合成集合。 路徑命中率65/100=65%，內容命中率50/80=62.5%；兩者分母不同，不能把其中一個稱為完整安全率。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Inhibition reduces notifications without deleting events; cross-tenant suppression must be counted separately from useful noise reduction. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Twelve targets include eight in tenant A and four in B; an A source should inhibit eight, but a missing tenant key suppresses all twelve. Four targets are suppressed incorrectly, or 33.333333% of the original target set, without implying a global risk probability.

Autopsy hash lookup compares files with configured sets, and changed sets may require ingest to run again. A match associates content with a set; it does not prove harmless context, use or execution behavior. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. There are 100 paths and eighty unique content hashes. Set v1 matches fifty distinct contents spread across sixty-five paths. Construct explicit synthetic sets so every count can be enumerated and checked. Path hit rate is 65/100=65%, while content hit rate is 50/80=62.5%. The denominators differ, and neither quantity is a comprehensive measure of security or benignness.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
